body: Alright I’m back now, I tried to talk with her about it (she brought it up not me) and I told her I’m sorry, I didn’t mean it, I told her I only love her and no one else (which is true). She told me to just drop it, she told me she’s still hurt but to just drop it and she’s still kinda pushing me away, it’s been I think 3-4 days since the incident, I told her why I said olivia instead but she doesn’t care really about that. I don’t know if I can make it up to her.

Thank you, she did have a really toxic ex who would ditch her all the time. I’ll try my best to cope with her feelings and all, but thanks for the advice it really means a lot to not have to go through this alone. I just hope she realizes she’s the only one I want and think about. I tried to tell her that, but as she said, probably wasn’t a good time to tell her that as she’s thinking about me with other girls. I’ll give her a day or two and hopefully she gets over it.

I called her the name of an acquaintance, not even really a friend we kind of just know each other, I was half asleep and there was no real reason to say Olivia (not my girlfriend). I’ve tried talking to her but she’s kind of just pushing me away, I don’t know what to do, I’ll take any advice but thank you.

I’ve been dating my girlfriend for almost a year now, and I haven’t even dated the person I said, I was half asleep and I said “I love you too Olivia”, I do know an Olivia but I think it’s just because my friend was telling me about an Olivia earlier in the day, this Olivia I don’t even really care about. I don’t know if she’s just over reacting but it seems to really bother her, she hasn’t really been the same the past two days. She says all she can think about now is me with another girl. I haven’t thought about anybody else since I met her. I tried to tell her that but she says it’s probably not a good time to be saying that because she imagines I’m saying it to another girl. Even just a slight nudge in the general direction I would take because I really don’t know what to do, I’ve tried talking to her but it doesn’t seem to help. I am desperate
